instruction: Start playing the video from this streaming link: https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/bipbop_adv_example_hevc/master.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using a different Apple HLS test stream (advanced HEVC example). Uses the same evaluator logic (is_vlc_playing) which checks VLC status XML for the URL. The evaluator verifies that VLC is in 'playing' state and the URL matches the expected stream URL.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks both playing state and URL match
Comprehensive URL matching logic with multiple fallback methods (direct match, HLS filename match, URL parsing)
Complete coverage of instruction requirements (playing state + specific URL)
Robust handling of HLS streams where VLC may report URL differently than input
Getter correctly retrieves VLC status via HTTP API
Data flow is semantically correct: XML extraction -> parsing -> state + URL verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The URL matching at vlc.py:102 uses 'in' operator which could theoretically match substrings, but this is mitigated by subsequent checks
Note: Config doesn't include actual URL opening steps (only launches VLC and clicks), but this is a task execution issue, not evaluator logic issue
